title: Tesla is asking people if they want to buy and run Cybercab fleets | TechCrunch
summary: Tesla published a form on Thursday for businesses interested in buying Cybercab fleets or providing infrastructure for its network, the latest sign that the company’s aspirations for its gold-hued autonomous vehicle stretch beyond being a robotaxi operator.
